notes.title: Update Notice for Version 1.0.2.61 of "Floating Life 2"
notes.content:
I. New Features and Optimizations
Added NPC killing gameplay; now players can kill NPCs.
II. Bug Fixes
Fixed the issue of increasing favorability in the brothel.
Fixed the problem where the Elder of the Sect's Spirit Pool couldn't cultivate.
Optimized the lag in the illustrated handbook.
Developed by Xinliu Studio, "Floating Life 2: Song of Nine Continents" is a sandbox cultivation game where players can customize their characters and interact with NPCs in real-time, experiencing a tumultuous cultivation journey together. As the game progresses, players can join various sects, explore rich adventure maps, and engage in freely combinable real-time battles, gradually uncovering the truth behind the world's anomalies and influencing the game's fate through their choices.
Now part of the Steam Autumn Sale, available at a 40% discount for a limited time. Steam page:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1934080/2_Floating_Life_2/
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42144619/d476be02281008ff16a7ab2e11191d503cfb12b0.jpg[/img]
I. Major Update to NPC Gameplay
The martial world is perilous, and the path of cultivation is fraught with thorns. The new NPC gameplay for "Old Day Female Cultivator" is now live. Players can choose to play as a demonic cultivator, enjoying the thrill of wanton behavior. When facing low-level cultivators who dare to challenge you, players can choose to kill them. If successful, players can obtain a begging item, sparing those NPCs who plead for mercy. However, this is not a simple victory; behind each life lies a story of grudges and conflicts. The hatred level of NPC relatives will increase, vowing to seek revenge. Conversely, if the player is defeated, they can offer an item to beg for mercy, hoping for clemency from the opponent. The path of cultivation is a fine line between becoming a deity and a demon, all depending on a single thought.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42144619/588a71a447a664cc25f0702df969455b751a5d51.jpg[/img]
A Short Story: The Demonic Cultivator and the Orphan Girl
Outside the outer sect of Yunxiao Sect, there was an orphaned girl cultivator named Ning An. Though her cultivation was not high, she had a righteous heart and always helped those in distress. One day, she encountered a demonic cultivator, a ruthless individual with profound cultivation. Despite knowing she was no match, Ning An stood up, attempting to stop the demonic cultivator from slaughtering the villagers. However, Ning An was ultimately defeated, falling severely injured. From her pocket, she took out a begging item and weakly handed it to the demonic cultivator: "Please... spare me..." The demonic cultivator sneered as he took the item, planting a seed of hatred in Ning An's heart. From then on, she vowed to increase her cultivation to avenge today's humiliation. This grudge will continue to unfold in the world of cultivation.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42144619/57dd38a75d3c5e57acf6adcf147f898d8f457848.jpg[/img]
For more information about this game, fellow cultivators can join the official game group: 805254230. Stay updated on the latest news of the "Floating Life" series, interact with the development team in real-time, report any issues encountered during gameplay, and provide your valuable feedback and suggestions.

notes.title: "Floating Life 2" Workshop Development Plan and Future Development Announced
notes.content:
Developed by HeartStream Studio, "Floating Life 2" is a sandbox-style cultivation game. Players can customize characters, interact with NPCs in real-time, and experience a tumultuous cultivation journey together. As the game progresses, players can join various cultivation sects, explore richly diverse adventure maps, and engage in free-form real-time combat. Gradually, players will uncover the truth behind the world's changes and steer the game world's destiny through their choices. The official version is now available for a limited-time 30% discount on the Steam page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1934080/2_Floating_Life_2/
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42144619/73f01dd68c2bd2811a72d8ae93d2d46e0cbc1cc7.jpg[/img]
"Floating Life 2" Workshop Development Plan
I. Workshop Development Plan
The development team's workshop will provide players with broader creative freedom:

1.Plot Module: Storyline flow, dialogue blocks, NPCs, conditions, automatic triggering, record values, etc. Players can create their own cultivation story MODs, including changing the character art, dialogue flow, etc.

2.Random Event Library: Players can create their own encounters in the cultivation world, including storylines, choices, rewards, illustrations, etc.

3.Experience Module: Experience flow, event, library, etc. Players can create stories for their own NPCs, making the cultivation world more colorful.

4.More Module Content: The development team is planning to add item, skill, instance, monster, etc., production modules. If players have any suggestions for needed modules, please leave feedback in the community group 805254230 or in the comment section, and the development team will consider and schedule production after discussion.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42144619/9fe19cc29259fcd548b8d96ed97c5d1571c3ab19.jpg[/img]
II. Future Development Plan

1.Spirit Beast System: Players can obtain spirit beast eggs and hatch spirit beasts from secret realms. The development team plans to develop dozens of spirit beasts for players to experience. Control, support, output, and other types of spirit beasts will fight alongside players, making the demon-slaying journey more rich and varied.

2.NPC Interaction Gameplay Expansion: Players will be able to interact with NPCs through marriage, forming sworn brothers, apprenticeship, etc. The development team will also add more NPC interaction gameplay, such as NPC killing, NPC proactive gifting, NPC proactive theft, NPC hunting, and deepen all NPC-related content to make the cultivation world more vibrant.

3.Sect Gameplay Optimization: The development team will enhance the connection between sects and characters, reduce the gaming pressure for players, plan to produce spiritual energy, spiritual stones, acquired traits, materials, etc., through sects, and optimize the newbie guide for sects, improving sect operations and interface.

4.Acquired Traits: The development team has launched character creation traits, and players hope to gain more traits. The development team plans to launch more fun and interesting traits for players to experience.

5.Equipment Affixes: The development team will add several sets of high-level equipment and an equipment affix development system. Players will be able to experience the random affix system and more percentage-based attributes.

6.Mood System: As the current system leans more towards players obtaining game items through grinding, which is time-consuming and not a good experience for players, the development team will sincerely accept everyone's feedback and add a mood system. Players can take a break after playing a dungeon, and more production will be added to the mood system gameplay. Responding to the national call to reduce the degree of grinding!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42144619/3480e1ab9629499f1247350e599c3edb5274158e.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42144619/d352b78d3ee17bfd31d2593cdc03e47142d7a354.jpg[/img]
The development team looks forward to active participation from players, injecting more vitality and innovation into the world of "Floating Life 2: A Song of Ninety-nine". The development team will continue to optimize the game based on player feedback, making it a memorable cultivation game.
Players who want to learn more about this game can join the official game group: 805254230, keep up-to-date with the latest developments in the "Floating Life" series, interact in real-time with the development team members, feedback any issues encountered during gameplay, and provide your valuable suggestions and advice.

notes.title: "Floating Life 2" Version 1.0.2.45 Update Announcement
notes.content:
"Floating Life 2" Version 1.0.2.45 Update Announcement

I. Function Optimization

1.Forge Function:
① You can now select the number of items to forge
② The required materials for forging will now be automatically added
③ The probability of forging high-level equipment has been increased
2.Bosses now have a small chance to drop their own skills
3.Added a function to lock character creation attributes
4.Now, you can improve affection with NPCs by sparring
5.New Qi-refining methods have been added to town and sect shops
6.The save file read with F9 has been changed to a manual save
7.The reduction of lifespan in initial attributes has been weakened
8.Added team formation guide
9.Optimized save file interface
10.Adjusted the skill set for initial battle
11.Increased the number of large spiritual energy points in the Southern Heaven Secret Realm
12.The automatic combat function can now be used from the first level of Qi-refining
13.Adjusted equipment sale prices
14.Optimized shop interface

II. Bug Fixes

1.Fixed the issue where other events could not be triggered after seizing spirit energy
2.Fixed the issue of abnormal distribution of mysterious bone piece related adventure items
3.Fixed the error where Qingmen NPC was incorrectly using banner skills
4.Fixed the issue where there was no rollback after failing a task
5.Fixed the issue where techniques cannot be purchased in "Crouching Dragon Valley"
6.Fixed the issue where the "Mending A Broken Mirror" task cannot be completed
7.Fixed the issue where spiritual energy points cannot be cultivated in "Thousand Rose Cave"
8.Fixed the issue where "Crouching Dragon Valley" in Southern Heaven Secret Realm cannot be entered
9.Fixed the issue where the Ice City Auction House cannot be found in the "Venturing into Tiger's Den" task
10.Fixed the issue where adventures in Southern Heaven Secret Realm do not trigger
11.Fixed errors in equipment descriptions

notes.title: 【限时8折】来吧！克苏鲁修仙《浮生箓2：九九行歌》新版本”天南秘境”现已更新
notes.content:
由心流工作室开发的修仙沙盒游戏《浮生箓2：九九行歌》现已发布了新的版本”天南秘境”，揭晓了新的克苏鲁修仙元素的大地图、新境界、抢夺灵气玩法、全新主线支线以及新的BOSS。将于13号限时8折活动。
Steam页面:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1934080/2_Floating_Life_2/

一、全新大地图——天南秘境
    在新版本中，玩家将解锁第三号大地图天南秘境。这里充满了克苏鲁修仙的元素，带来了全新的探索体验。在天南秘境中，玩家可以体验到各种独特的环境和有趣的挑战。
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42144619/1ad9fe34811f3cc4cd90108ebee49f496bad3377.png[/img]

二、新境界——化神、炼虚
新版本中，玩家将会解锁全新的境界化神、炼虚。通过此境界，玩家可以进一步提升自身的实力，达到前所未有的高度。化神、炼虚将为玩家带来全新境界体验，渡雷劫，化元神，一起来修仙。
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42144619/8216d35f1854c9b2ee19102b7e0321b6f4f1a143.png[/img]

三、新玩法——抢夺灵气
在新版本中，抢夺灵气的玩法将给玩家提供更多的挑战和乐趣。玩家需要在战斗中运用策略和NPC抢夺灵气，体验修仙世界的境界碾压和修仙的残酷，资源匮乏的环境下，只有少数人可修成正道。
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42144619/26460cb1182f272901714071ac8dc038e6260666.png[/img]

四、全新大妖兽——程星剑
在新版本中，全新的大妖兽——程星剑将登场。与之战斗将是一次极具挑战性的试炼，玩家需要充分利用自己的策略和灵力来对抗这个强大的敌人，更多新的大妖兽，等你来体验。
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42144619/2a32c4995bec9043901cd8d8b427f8f3406cb8f0.png[/img]

五、新主线与支线——天南秘境剧情
在新版本中，全新的主线任务和支线任务将为玩家提供更多的探索和挑战。通过完成这些任务，玩家可以深入了解《浮生箓2：九九行歌》的世界观和故事。
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42144619/8c6ceea3afe5a79293d7dfa663276b6fd2def03f.png[/img]

六、新养成——天赋系统用
在新版本中，全新的天赋系统，道友可以体验到各式各样的天赋加点。
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42144619/6bd38e8b9aff8163102ad1f4997a32210eac7f17.png[/img]

七、新玩法——拍卖行
在新版本中，各大城镇增加了各种奇珍异宝，等道友来探索。
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42144619/9532129e074e89af081949743d976b9a701b933e.png[/img]

notes.title: [1.0.0.1试玩版本]6.1更新公告
notes.content:
感谢各位道友的积极反馈，我们修复了一些群内玩家提交的bug和一些优化，非常感谢各位支持~

优化：
1.优化了分辨率显示问题。
2.去掉了随机NPC背包中非正式道具。
3.降低了击飞和受击的频率。
4.优化了可操作按钮高亮显示。
5.优化了不可出售的道具同时也不能交易的问题。
6.减少了任务中的叠字显示。

Bug修复：
1.玩家可以卡位置杀死邪修，臆念等怪物问题。
2.技能CD秒数修改。
3.攻击范围增大。
4.连刺技能对分身怪物没伤害的问题。
5.战斗中打开快捷菜单暂停战斗。
